fieldRules.author: Must match a slug in src/data/team.ts (currently: arjun, priya)
fieldRules.tags: 1–3 tags. Prefer existing catalog tags; new tags fragment clusters.
fieldRules.cover: Relative path like ./<slug>-cover.png. Generate via `pnpm run blog:covers <slug>`.
fieldRules.summary: ≤25 words. Compressed lede. Reused as meta description, RSS summary, OG description.

antiPatterns: No direct answer in the lede

within24h: Verify URL appears in `pnpm run gsc:check` sitemap status
Submit URL via Google Search Console 'Request indexing' UI
Cross-post to dev.to + Hashnode with canonical tag
Twitter/X thread (3–5 tweets) summarizing post with link
Submit to single most-relevant subreddit (not cross-post)
within7days: Re-run `pnpm run citations:check` — target prompt should move toward us (Perplexity Sonar fastest)
If we win the prompt, move to next loser-prompt brief
If not, tighten lede and republish with bumped updatedAt
within30days: Audit competitor pages we're winning back
Refresh lowest-performing post (same slug, new lede, bumped updatedAt) — don't write a new one

agentDraftingFlow: 1. `pnpm run loser-prompts` → pick highest-priority losing prompt
2. Fetch this JSON → choose template by headline pattern
4. Generate post draft conforming to playbook (sections, frontmatter, lede ≤60 words)
5. Run quality-bar checklist in section 14 of playbook before marking draft: false
